# Hormone Therapy Hub

> Peggy's first-person guide to online hormone replacement therapy (HRT) and bioidentical hormone replacement therapy (BHRT). She writes from personal experience. She is not a doctor, and the site does not give medical advice. Some visit links are affiliate links.

Hormone Therapy Hub helps someone compare telehealth clinics for menopause and other hormone-related symptoms. A clinic page covers how that clinic works, what it offers, pricing, insurance, and HSA or FSA policy when Peggy has confirmed those facts. The long reviews live as posts.

Read each page as three kinds of information. Her experience is what she used, what she paid, and what it was like for her. Clinic-reported facts, such as insurance, formulations, labs, states, and how to get started, are what she confirmed on that clinic's own page. Guides are educational. None of this is a diagnosis or a treatment plan.

Prices and coupon codes change. The figure on a clinic page or the price chart is the one she last checked, and the chart is dated. A review stays the story of the time she used that clinic. Someone else's price can differ.

Visit buttons on clinic pages can pay her a commission. That does not change the review. How she decides what to publish, including the affiliate relationship, is on How I review.

There is no booking, checkout, or agent API. These pages are the source. The canonical host is https://www.hormonetherapyhub.com, with no trailing slash. Posts live under /post/. The sitemap lists every indexable URL.

Clinics she has written up: Inner Balance (including its Oestra cream), Winona, Musely, Alloy, Joi Women's Wellness, Effecty, MyMenopauseRx, Midi Health, and HRT Doctors Group.

- [FAQ](https://www.hormonetherapyhub.com/faq): Common questions about bioidentical hormone therapy.
